hooks.name: Project graph: mark work started
hooks.description: After launching a workflow, set the project graph node it works on to doing, so the graph matches reality.

action.prompt: A workflow was just launched. If it works on a node of the project graph (docs/graph), set that node to doing now through the graph engine (actor llm, reason naming the run label), unless it already is, then run npm run -s graph:render and commit the node files with the next graph commit. The graph is the only progress record (CHARTER clause 11).
